headline: Singapore Airlines to Purchase Sustainable Aviation Fuel from Aether
summary: Singapore Airlines agreed to buy up to 4,800 tonnes of sustainable aviation fuel produced from waste carbon feedstocks at Aether's Singapore plant.
why: Airline procurement of sustainable aviation fuel addresses corporate carbon reduction targets and regulatory mandates within the commercial aviation sector.

impacts.name: Singapore Airlines Ltd
impacts.why: Purchasing sustainable aviation fuel supports decarbonization goals but generally incurs a higher fuel cost premium.
